item.title: GTA VI Sales: How a Game Made $3.79 Billion in One Day
item.dc:creator: xclnt-sensai
item.description: GTA VI reportedly made $3.79 billion in 24 hours. Here’s what the record really measures, what the numbers leave out, and why 13 years of waiting paid off.

item.title: SpaceX’s 1 Million Satellite Plan: Data Centers in Space
item.dc:creator: xclnt-sensai
item.description: The FCC just approved SpaceX’s plan for 1 million satellites to run AI data centers in orbit. Here’s what’s real, what’s hype, and what worries scientists.
